name: gmail
description: Gmail integration (restricted scope). Requires a BYO Google OAuth client — first-party OAuth is not available for Gmail.

auth.label: Google (Gmail — BYO only)
auth.hint: Restricted scope: paste your own Google OAuth client JSON (no one-click connect). Grant the https://mail.google.com/ scope. Can be shared with google-sheets/google-tasks.

setupGuide.summary: Gmail uses a restricted Google permission, so this connection requires your own Google OAuth app — one-click Google connection is not available for Gmail. Create a Google Cloud OAuth client and paste its downloaded JSON here. The client belongs to your Google Cloud project and can be revoked from Google or OrgSDK later.
prerequisites: Access to create or edit a Google Cloud project.
Permission to configure the project's OAuth consent screen and credentials.
A Google account that can authorize the requested workspace data.

steps.title: Open or create a Google Cloud project
steps.description: Use an existing project or create a new one to hold the OAuth client for Gmail.

steps.title: Enable the Gmail API
steps.description: Gmail requires the Gmail API. Enable it in APIs & Services for this project.

steps.title: Configure the OAuth consent screen
steps.description: Set the consent screen to External (or Internal for Workspace). Add your own Google account as a test user while the app remains in testing — Google's full verification process is separate from this inline flow.

steps.title: Create a Web application OAuth client
steps.description: Create credentials of type OAuth client ID. The application type must be Web application — not Desktop app or another type.

steps.title: Add the authorized redirect URI
steps.description: Copy the OrgSDK callback URL below and paste it under Authorized redirect URIs (not under Authorized JavaScript origins).

steps.title: Download the OAuth client JSON
steps.description: Download the client configuration and paste the complete file contents into the field below. It contains a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Connect Gmail
steps.description: Saving valid JSON enables the authorization action. Complete Google's consent screen and return here — the connection refreshes in place.

callback.label: Authorized redirect URI
callback.instruction: Paste this exact URL into the OAuth client's Authorized redirect URIs list.

configField.label: Google OAuth client JSON
configField.description: Paste the complete contents of the JSON file downloaded for the Web application OAuth client. It contains a client ID and client secret.

https://mail.google.com/.label: Read, compose, send, and manage your Gmail

marketplace.tagline: Give agents a scoped Gmail inbox — search threads, extract attachments, draft replies, and send templated email on a schedule.
useCases: Triage a label by priority and surface threads that need a reply
Draft and send replies that match the thread context
Extract attachments and parse PDFs (e.g. invoices, expense reports)
Route receipt threads to a Google Sheet and mark them processed
Send templated notifications or reports with attachments
marketplace.permissionsSummary: Read, modify labels on, and send Gmail messages via a restricted OAuth scope. Reading and labeling are reversible; sending and replying are mutating.
